DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今日は教える側の見学でよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Ngayon po ay obserbasyon bilang tagapagturo, tama?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 日本語を学ぶつもりで来ました。フォームのボランティアという欄を選んだので、教える側になっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 学習希望なのに教える側になった登録を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Para po matuto ng Japanese ang punta ko. Pinili ko ang volunteer sa form; naging tagapagturo po ba ang registration?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Itanong ang pagiging tagapagturo kahit pag-aaral ang nais. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その希望で届いています。学ぶ方の参加希望とは分けて確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Ganoon ang natanggap. Hiwalay naming titiyakin sa pagsali bilang mag-aaral.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 無料で参加する人の意味だと思っていました。講師の希望ではなく、学習者として相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: ボランティア欄の誤解を訂正し学習者希望を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Akala ko po taong sasali nang libre ang ibig sabihin. Hindi guro, mag-aaral ang gusto kong isangguni.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Itama ang volunteer misunderstanding at sabihin ang learner role. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 担当が参加方法を案内します。今日は学習者の席を確保済みとは限りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Ituturo ang pagsali. Hindi tiyak na may nakareserbang learner seat ngayon.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今すぐ授業へ入れると考えず、条件を聞きます。学びたいのは職場で使う報告の日本語です。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 即参加を決めず職場報告を学びたいと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Hindi ko po ipapalagay na makakapasok agad; pakikinggan ang kondisyon. Japanese sa pag-uulat sa trabaho ang gusto kong aralin.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Huwag asahang agad sasali at sabihin ang pag-aaral ng work reports. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その希望を担当へ伝えます。以前のフォームの扱いも確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Ipapasa ang gusto ninyo. Tiyakin din ang dating form.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 二つの希望が同時に残らないよう、前の送信を訂正する方法を教えてください。自分で新しく何度も送るのは待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 重複送信を避け既送信の役割訂正方法を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Pakituro po ang pagwawasto sa naipadala para walang dalawang role na matira. Hindi muna ako paulit-ulit na magsusumite.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Iwasan ang duplicate at itanong ang pagbabago ng dating role. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当が記録の訂正と、学習者の案内を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Titiyakin ang correction at learner guide sa namamahala.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。役割を学習者として直し、参加条件が分かってから次の見学日を決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 役割訂正と参加条件確認後に見学日を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Pakiusap po. Itatama sa learner at kapag alam ang kondisyon saka pipili ng susunod na observation day.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Itama ang role at pumili ng pagbisita matapos malaman ang kondisyon. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、その二点を担当へ引き継ぎます。教える側の登録としては進めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Ipapasa ang dalawa. Hindi ipoproseso bilang teaching registration.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今日はどのような行程をお考えですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Anong itinerary po ang iniisip ninyo ngayon?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 一時間だけ歩きたいです。この下山の矢印なら、登山口の近くを一周して戻れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 下山矢印で一時間周回できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Isang oras lang po akong lalakad. Sa downhill arrow ba ay maiikot ang malapit sa trailhead at makababalik?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Itanong kung isang oras na loop ang downhill arrow. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その表示だけで周回路とは判断できません。どの地点へ出る道か案内図を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Hindi masasabi sa sign lang na loop. Tingnan ang mapa kung saan lalabas.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 元の場所へ戻る方向だと思っていました。登山口に戻る計画とは分けて、行先を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 矢印の行先と元の登山口への帰着を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Akala ko po pabalik sa dati. Hiwalay sa pagbabalik sa trailhead, pakisabi ang destinasyon.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ihiwalay ang arrow destination at pagbabalik sa orihinal na trailhead. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この道は別の出口へ向かう案内です。現在の通行状況も確認が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Ibang exit ang tinuturo. Kailangang tiyakin din ang kasalukuyang daan.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 別の出口では、ここに置いた自分の荷物へ戻れません。今日はその道に入らず、近くで戻れる範囲を相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 別出口では荷物へ戻れずその道に入らないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Kung iba po, hindi ako babalik sa gamit ko rito. Hindi ako papasok doon ngayon; magtatanong ng malapit na may balikan.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Sabihing hindi papasok dahil ibang exit at hindi makabalik sa gamit. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 荷物を預かる条件も別に確認してください。通れる範囲と所要時間は当日の案内で確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Tiyakin din nang hiwalay ang baggage storage. Sa gabay ngayon malalaman ang daan at oras.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 荷物をここで預かってもらえると決めていました。まだ置いていかず、持ち歩ける範囲から考え直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 預かり未確認を認め荷物を持てる行程へ見直す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Akala ko po puwede nang iwan dito. Hindi ko muna iiwan; magpaplano muli ayon sa kaya kong dalhin.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Amining hindi pa tiyak ang storage at baguhin sa rutang may dalang gamit. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当が現在の案内を説明します。一時間で必ず戻れるという保証にはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Ipapaliwanag ang gabay ngayon. Hindi ito garantiya ng isang oras na balik.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。荷物の扱いと今の通行情報を聞き、無理な周回を前提にせず行程を決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 荷物条件と当日通行情報を確認して計画する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Sige po. Pakikinggan ang gamit at daan at hindi magpaplano ng sapilitang loop.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Tiyakin ang baggage conditions at kasalukuyang daan bago magplano. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では案内図を一緒に見ましょう。確認前にその矢印の道へ進まないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Tingnan natin ang mapa. Huwag sundan ang arrow bago matiyak.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 不在票のどの部分を確認されたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Aling bahagi po ng missed delivery slip ang tatanungin?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この日付が受取り日だと思いました。当日その時間までに来れば、荷物を必ず受け取れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 保管期限を受取予約日と思ったと尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Akala ko po receiving date ito. Kung dumating sa oras na iyon sa araw na iyon, tiyak bang makukuha?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Itanong ang pag-aakalang collection appointment ang storage deadline. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 保管期限の表示と、来局する希望日時は別です。番号で現在の扱いを確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Magkaiba ang storage deadline at gusto ninyong oras ng pagpunta. Tiyakin sa numero ang kasalukuyang status.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 予約された受取り日ではなかったのですね。まだ受取方法の申込みはしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 受取方法未申込と期限の意味を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Hindi po pala nakatakdang pickup. Hindi pa ako nag-apply ng paraan ng pagtanggap.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Sabihing wala pang application at tiyakin ang deadline meaning. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この荷物の状況と、選べる方法を確認します。来局できる日はいつですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Titiyakin ang parcel at options. Kailan po kayo makakapunta?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 期限の日しか来られませんが、遅い時間です。窓口の受付時間と、荷物の期限を同じに考えないよう確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 遅い来局希望を伝え窓口時間と期限を分けて聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Sa deadline day lang po at gabi na. Gusto kong hiwalay na tiyakin ang counter hours at parcel deadline.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang huling pagpunta at hiwalay na itanong ang counter hours at deadline. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: どちらの条件も担当が確認します。期限の表示だけで来局時刻を決めないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Parehong titiyakin ng staff. Huwag sa deadline sign lang magtakda ng oras ng punta.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 確認前に移動せず、難しい場合に相談できる方法も聞きたいです。期限が自動で延びるとも思いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 移動前に方法を相談し自動延長を前提にしない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Hindi po muna bibiyahe bago matiyak; gusto kong malaman ang puwedeng konsultasyon kung hindi kaya. Hindi ko rin aasahan ang automatic extension.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Magtanong bago bumiyahe at huwag asahang awtomatikong hahaba ang deadline. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当から現在の状況と可能な手順を案内します。票は残しておいてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Ituturo ang status at hakbang. Itabi ang slip.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。票の番号で確認し、受付時間と保管期限に合う方法が分かってから手続きします。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 番号と二つの条件確認後に受取手続きをする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Opo. Titiyakin sa numero at magpoproseso kapag alam ang paraan na tugma sa hours at deadline.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Matapos ang numero at dalawang kondisyon, gawin ang pagtanggap. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では担当が調べます。受取りが確定した扱いにはせず、お待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Susuriin ng staff. Maghintay nang hindi itinuturing na tiyak ang pagkuha.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: カードの紛失についてですね。何を確認したいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Tungkol po sa nawawalang card. Ano ang gustong tiyakin?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: カードをなくしました。止めると家賃も払えなくなると思い、届けるのを迷っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 紛失カード停止で家賃も払えないと思い届けを迷ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Nawala po ang card. Nag-atubiling mag-ulat dahil akala ko kapag hinarang, hindi na rin makabayad ng renta.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag ang pag-atubili dahil inakalang card blocking ay pipigil sa renta. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: カードの利用停止と口座の引き落としは、同じ手続きとして決めずに確認します。まず紛失の受付を進めてよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Hiwalay na titiyakin ang card stop at account debit. Maaari bang unahin ang lost card report?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、紛失の受付をお願いします。家賃の心配を理由にカードの届けを後回しにはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 家賃への懸念と分けてカード紛失受付を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Opo, paki-report. Hindi ko ipagpapaliban dahil sa renta.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Humiling ng lost-card report nang hiwalay sa renta concern. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 家賃はカードで支払っていますか。それとも口座からの引き落としですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Sa card ba ang renta o account debit?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 契約の紙には口座振替とあります。カード払いだと思っていましたが、この記載を見て確認してほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 契約の口座振替記載を示しカード払いとの誤解を訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Account transfer po sa kontrata. Akala ko card payment pero pakitingnan ang nakasulat.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ipakita ang account debit sa kontrata at itama ang card payment na akala. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 予定日と金額も確認担当へ伝えます。家賃について何か変更の申し込みをしましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Ipapasa rin ang petsa at halaga. May na-request na bang pagbabago sa renta?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: まだしていません。来週の二十七日に六万円の予定です。カードを止めるために口座も解約する、という依頼はしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 予定日金額と未変更を伝え口座解約の依頼ではないと明示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Wala pa po. 60,000 yen sa ika-27 sa susunod na linggo. Hindi ko hinihiling na isara pati account para ihinto ang card.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang petsa, halaga at wala pang pagbabago, at linawing hindi account closure. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 紛失対応と予定の口座振替をそれぞれ確認します。確認前に別の方法で家賃を払う予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Hiwalay na titiyakin ang pagkawala at debit. Balak po bang ibang bayad bago matiyak?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: いいえ、二重払いにならないよう、引き落とし予定の扱いを聞いてから決めます。家主へ連絡が必要なら、何が未確認かを伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 確認前の別払いを保留し未確認の予定を家主へ伝える方針を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Hindi po. Para walang dobleng bayad, pakikinggan muna ang scheduled debit. Kung kailangang tawagan ang landlord, sasabihin kung ano ang hindi pa tiyak.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ipagpaliban ang ibang bayad at sabihing ipapaalam sa landlord ang hindi tiyak. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その内容で受け付けます。カードの紛失対応を進め、口座振替については担当から確認結果と必要な手順をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-HACHIOJI-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Tatanggapin nang ganoon. Ipoproseso ang card loss at ipapaliwanag ang debit result at hakbang.

DLG-SC-TKY-ITABASHI-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-ITABASHI-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お持ちの袋へ入れてよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-TKY-ITABASHI-001-SHARED-01.translation: Maaari pong ilagay sa dala ninyong bag?

DLG-SC-TKY-ITABASHI-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-ITABASHI-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい、お願いします。あ、底から手が見えます。袋が破れているので、まだ入れないでください。
DLG-SC-TKY-ITABASHI-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 持参袋の破れに気づき袋詰めを止める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-ITABASHI-001-SHARED-02.translation: Opo. Ay, kita ang kamay ko sa ilalim. Punit pala; huwag munang lagyan.
DLG-SC-TKY-ITABASHI-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Itigil ang paglalagay nang mapansing punit ang sariling bag. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-ITABASHI-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-ITABASHI-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: では袋詰めを止めます。こちらの袋をご購入になりますか。
DLG-SC-TKY-ITABASHI-001-SHARED-03.translation: Ititigil muna. Bibili po ba ng bag namin?

DLG-SC-TKY-ITABASHI-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-ITABASHI-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 家から持ってきた袋の破れです。お店の袋の不具合ではありません。新しい袋の大きさを見たいです。
DLG-SC-TKY-ITABASHI-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 持参品の問題と説明し新袋のサイズを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-ITABASHI-001-SHARED-04.translation: Sarili ko pong bag ang punit, hindi depekto ng tindahan. Pakitingnan ang laki ng bago.
DLG-SC-TKY-ITABASHI-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag na sariling gamit ang sira at tingnan ang bagong size. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-ITABASHI-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-ITABASHI-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらの大きさです。重い品は、袋に入れても持ち方を確認してください。
DLG-SC-TKY-ITABASHI-001-SHARED-05.translation: Ganito ang laki. Kahit nasa bag ang mabigat, tiyakin ang paghawak.

DLG-SC-TKY-ITABASHI-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-ITABASHI-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 牛乳と瓶があります。破れた袋を外側へ重ねてごまかさず、新しい袋で無理なく運べるか考えます。
DLG-SC-TKY-ITABASHI-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 重い中身を示し破袋で隠さず運び方を考える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-ITABASHI-001-SHARED-06.translation: May gatas at bote po. Hindi ko pagtatakpan sa pagpapatong ng punit; pag-iisipan kung kayang dalhin sa bago.
DLG-SC-TKY-ITABASHI-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang mabigat na laman at pag-isipan ang pagdadala nang hindi itinatago sa punit. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-ITABASHI-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-ITABASHI-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この場で全部一袋にまとめる必要はありません。持ち分を分けるご希望も伺えます。
DLG-SC-TKY-ITABASHI-001-SHARED-07.translation: Hindi kailangang lahat sa isang bag. Puwede ang paghahati ng dadalhin.

DLG-SC-TKY-ITABASHI-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-ITABASHI-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 瓶は持参した別の丈夫な袋へ、牛乳などは購入する袋へ分けたいです。両方の底を先に確認します。
DLG-SC-TKY-ITABASHI-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 二つの使用可能な袋に中身を分け底を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-ITABASHI-001-SHARED-08.translation: Bote po sa isa ko pang matibay na bag at gatas at iba pa sa bibilhin. Titingnan ko muna ang ilalim ng pareho.
DLG-SC-TKY-ITABASHI-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Hatiin sa dalawang maayos na bag at tiyakin ang ilalim. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-ITABASHI-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-ITABASHI-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 分けてお渡しします。購入する袋の料金はこちらです。
DLG-SC-TKY-ITABASHI-001-SHARED-09.translation: Ihihiwalay namin. Ito ang presyo ng bagong bag.

DLG-SC-TKY-ITABASHI-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-ITABASHI-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 料金を確認しました。新しい袋を一枚購入し、破れた自分の袋は空のまま持ち帰ります。
DLG-SC-TKY-ITABASHI-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 料金確認後に新袋一枚を買い破袋は空で持ち帰る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-ITABASHI-001-SHARED-10.translation: Natiyak ko po. Isang bagong bag ang bibilhin at iuuwi nang bakante ang punit kong bag.
DLG-SC-TKY-ITABASHI-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Bumili ng isang bag matapos tiyakin ang presyo at iuwi nang walang laman ang punit. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-ITABASHI-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-ITABASHI-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。その分け方で袋詰めします。
DLG-SC-TKY-ITABASHI-001-SHARED-11.translation: Sige po. Ibabalot ayon sa hati.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: この部品は、改訂版の図面で確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Sa revised drawing tiyakin ang piyesang ito.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 新しい版なので、前の寸法は全部使えないと思いました。機械の設定も全部変えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 新版で全寸法設定を変えるべきか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Dahil bago po, akala ko hindi na puwede lahat ng dating sukat. Lahat din ba ng setting babaguhin?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Itanong kung lahat ng sukat at setting babaguhin dahil bagong drawing. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 改訂した範囲を確認する必要があります。図面が新しいだけで全設定を変更しないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Tiyakin ang revised scope. Huwag lahat baguhin dahil bago lang ang drawing.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ変更していません。改訂番号と変更した箇所を担当に示してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未変更を伝え改訂番号と変更箇所確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Hindi ko pa po binago. Pakipakita sa namamahala ang revision number at changed areas.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Sabihing hindi pa binago at humiling ng revision number at pagbabago. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 担当が旧版と新版を照合します。作業台に旧版が残っていますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Ihahambing ang luma at bago. May luma pa sa mesa.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 旧版を黙って混ぜておかず、どちらを作業用に使うか確認します。自分で旧版へ数字を書き足すこともしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 旧新版を混ぜず旧版へ自己追記しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Hindi ko po tahimik na ihahalo. Titiyakin ang pangtrabaho at hindi ko sariling dadagdagan ng numero ang luma.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Huwag paghaluin ang bersiyon o sariling dagdagan ang luma. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: そのまま二つを担当へ見せてください。途中まで加工した物はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Ipakita pareho nang ganoon. May bahagyang nagawa na?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 一個あります。新しい図面で加工済みとは報告せず、旧版でどこまで進めたかを伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 旧版で途中加工した一個の工程を報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: May isa po. Hindi ko iuulat na sa bagong drawing nagawa; sasabihin kung hanggang saan sa luma.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Iulat ang isang bahagyang naproseso sa lumang bersiyon. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当がその一個の扱いも判断します。設定と加工は確認が終わるまで進めないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Staff ang magpapasya pati roon. Huwag ituloy ang setting o paggawa bago matiyak.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。版番号、未変更の設定、途中の一個を分けて報告し、適用範囲の指示を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 図面版と設定状態と途中品を分け指示を待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Sige po. Ihiwalay ang version, hindi binagong setting at isang nasa gitna at hihintayin ang scope instruction.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Iulat nang hiwalay ang version, setting at partial piece at maghintay. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その状態を確認します。新版の変更点から一緒に見ましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Titiyakin ang kalagayan. Sabay tingnan ang bagong pagbabago.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 症状欄が空いていますが、今日はどのようなご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Blangko ang symptoms. Ano po ang konsultasyon ngayon?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 今は痛くないので、症状なしとしました。でも昨日から食べ物を噛む時に痛みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 現在無痛だが噛む時の痛みがあると補足する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Wala pong sakit ngayon kaya inilagay kong wala. Pero masakit kapag ngumunguya mula kahapon.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Dagdagang walang sakit ngayon ngunit may sakit sa pagnguya. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今の状態と、噛んだ時の症状を分けて担当へ伝えます。場所は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Ihihiwalay sa staff ang ngayon at pagnguya. Alam po ang lugar?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 自分の右の奥です。どの歯かは特定できないので、右奥の辺りと伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 右奥の範囲を示し歯を特定できないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Sa kanan ko pong likod. Hindi ko matukoy ang ngipin kaya pakisabing bandang kanang likod.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ituro ang kanang likod at sabihing hindi matukoy ang ngipin. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その範囲で記録します。今も噛んで確かめる必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Ganoon ang itatala. Hindi kailangang subukang ngumunguya ngayon.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 試すために強く噛むことはしません。昨日の食事で気づいたことと、今はじっとしていると痛くないことを話します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 強く噛んで試さず発見時と安静時の状態を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Hindi po ako malakas na kakagat para subukan. Sasabihin ang napansin sa pagkain kahapon at walang sakit kapag hindi gumagalaw ngayon.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Huwag malakas na kumagat at ipaliwanag ang pagkakita at resting status. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 診療担当が確認します。以前の受診について伝えたいことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Susuriin ng medical staff. May gustong sabihin sa dating paggamot?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 別の医院で治療したことはありますが、この医院は初めてです。前の治療場所が今回の原因とは自分で決めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 当院初診と他院治療歴を原因断定と分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: May paggamot po sa ibang clinic pero una rito. Hindi ko ituturing na dating ginamot ang sanhi ngayon.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ihiwalay ang first visit at ibang paggamot sa tiyak na sanhi. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 初診としてご案内します。分かる範囲の治療歴も担当に伝えられます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Bilang first visit ang gabay. Sabihin din ang alam na treatment history.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。症状なしという記入を直し、噛む時の右奥の痛みと昨日からの経過を説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 症状なし記入を訂正し部位と経過を引き継ぐ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Pakiusap po. Itatama ang walang sintomas at ipapaliwanag ang kanang likod sa pagnguya at takbo mula kahapon.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Itama ang walang sintomas at ipasa ang lugar at takbo. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その内容で担当に引き継ぎます。こちらで受診案内をお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Ipapasa iyan. Dito hintayin ang consultation guide.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お弁当のおかずと、ご飯をお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Ibibigay ang ulam at kanin ng bento.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: おかずだけの箱だと思いました。ご飯を追加で一つ注文した方がよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: ご飯別容器の弁当に追加ご飯が必要か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Akala ko po ulam lang. Kailangan bang umorder pa ng isang kanin?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Itanong kung kailangan ng dagdag na kanin sa bentong hiwalay ang lalagyan. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この注文は、ご飯を別の容器でお渡しする内容です。まだ追加は必要ありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Kasama sa order ang kanin sa ibang lalagyan. Hindi pa kailangan ng dagdag.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ご飯が含まれていない意味ではなかったのですね。今の注文の二つの容器を見せてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 元注文に含まれると確認し二容器の提示を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Hindi po pala ibig sabihing walang kanin. Maaari bang makita ang dalawang lalagyan ng kasalukuyang order?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Tiyaking kasama at hilinging makita ang dalawang lalagyan. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらの組です。別の注文のご飯と混ぜず、お渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Ito ang pares. Hindi ihahalo sa kanin ng ibang order.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この二つで一人分ですね。ご飯だけ隣の人の物だと思って置いていかないよう、一緒に受け取ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 二つで一人分と理解して他人の物と混同しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Dalawa po para sa isa. Tatanggapin nang sabay para hindi maiwan ang kanin sa pag-aakalang sa katabi.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Unawaing dalawa ang isang serving at huwag ipagpalit sa gamit ng iba. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 袋は二つの容器が入るものをご用意できます。ご飯をおかずの容器へ移す必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: May bag para sa dalawa. Hindi kailangang ilipat ang kanin sa ulam.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 自分で一箱へ詰め直さず、このまま運びます。友人に渡す時も二つで一つの弁当だと伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 容器を詰め直さず二つ一組で友人へ渡す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Hindi ko po pagsasamahin sa isang kahon; ganito dadalhin. Sasabihin din sa kaibigan na dalawa ang isang bento.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Huwag muling ipasok sa isa at ibigay sa kaibigan bilang pares. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 追加のご飯は注文しないということでよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Wala nang dagdag na kanin, tama?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。別添えのご飯が含まれると確認できたので、追加せずこの二つを受け取ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: ご飯追加を取り止め元の二容器を受け取る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Opo. Natiyak na kasama ang hiwalay na kanin kaya dalawa lang na ito, walang dagdag.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Itigil ang dagdag na kanin at tanggapin ang orihinal na pares. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。二つを一組として袋へお入れします。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Sige po. Ilalagay sa bag bilang isang pares.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 予約相談の準備について、ご説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Ipapaliwanag ang paghahanda sa consultation appointment.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 日時は聞き取れましたが、書類の名前が分かりません。全部理解したことにせず、文字で見せてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 日時は理解したが書類名未理解で文字提示を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Naunawaan ko po ang oras pero hindi ang document name. Hindi ko sasabihing lahat alam; maaari bang ipakita sa sulat?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Sabihing alam ang oras ngunit hindi ang dokumento at humiling ng sulat. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 書類名はこちらです。日時の案内も一緒に見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Ito ang document name. Tingnan pati ang oras.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。音で聞いた別の書類と混同していました。この名前をそのままメモします。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 聞いた別書類との混同を認め正式名を記録する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Salamat po. Napagpalit sa ibang dokumentong narinig. Itatala ko itong pangalan nang eksakto.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Aminin ang napagpalit na dokumento at itala ang pormal na pangalan. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今お持ちの物が、その書類か分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Alam po kung ito ang dala ninyo?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 写真がありますが、似た名前なので自分で同じと決めず、表題を見ていただきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 持参候補の表題を示し同一書類か確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: May larawan po pero kahawig ang pangalan; huwag kong basta itulad, pakitingnan ang pamagat.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ipakita ang pamagat ng kandidatong dokumento at humiling ng pagtutugma. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 必要な書類について担当が確認します。聞こえにくい場合と、言葉の意味が分からない場合は分けて教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Titiyakin ang kailangan sa staff. Ihiwalay kung hindi marinig o hindi alam ang kahulugan.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 声は聞こえています。日本語の書類名と意味が分からないので、大声にするより文字と説明で確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 聴取音量でなく語の理解の問題と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Naririnig ko po. Japanese document name at kahulugan ang hindi alam, kaya sulat at paliwanag sa halip na lakasan.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag na pag-unawa sa salita ang problema at hindi lakas ng tunog. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 分かりました。文字で示しながら、担当へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Sige po. Ipapakita sa sulat habang tinitiyak sa staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。書類名を見て、何を持参するか自分の言葉で言い返して確認します。日時のメモとは別に残します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 書類目的を復唱して日時と別に持参物を記録する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Pakiusap po. Titingnan ang pangalan at uulitin sa sarili kong salita ang dadalhin. Hiwalay sa oras ang memo.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ulitin ang layunin ng dokumento at itala ang dadalhin nang hiwalay sa oras. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、書類の表題と目的から説明します。分からない部分は途中でお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Mula sa pamagat at layunin ang paliwanag. Sabihin agad ang hindi malinaw.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 棚についてお困りですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 空いていると思った棚にポーチがありました。端へ移して自分の服を置いてよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 他人のポーチを移して棚を使えるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: May pouch sa shelf na akala ko bakante. Puwede bang ilipat sa gilid para mailagay ang damit ko?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Itanong kung maaaring ilipat ang pouch ng iba para magamit ang shelf. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 持ち主が戻るかもしれません。お客様が移動せず、場所を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Baka bumalik ang may-ari. Huwag ilipat; sabihin ang lugar.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ触っていません。入口から二列目の下の棚です。忘れ物か、使用中の物かまでは分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未接触と棚位置を示し所有状況不明を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Hindi ko pa po hinawakan. Ilalim na shelf sa ikalawang hanay mula pasukan. Hindi ko alam kung naiwan o kasalukuyang gamit.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Sabihing hindi nahawakan, tukuyin ang shelf at hindi tiyak ang ownership status. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 係が確認します。別の空き棚をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Staff ang titingin. Ituturo ang ibang bakante.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。ポーチの中を見て持ち主を探すことはせず、自分は別の棚を使います。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 中を調べず別の棚を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Pakiusap po. Hindi ko bubuksan para hanapin ang may-ari; iba ang gagamitin ko.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Huwag suriin ang loob at humiling ng ibang shelf. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確認は係が行います。先ほどその棚へご自身の物を入れましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Staff ang susuri. May nailagay na po kayong sariling gamit doon?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: タオルだけ置きました。ポーチは触らず、自分のタオルを取り出す時も係に確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 自分のタオルだけ置いたと報告し回収の確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Tuwalya lang po. Hindi ko gagalawin ang pouch at ipagtatanong ko rin sa staff bago kunin ang tuwalya ko.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Iulat ang sariling tuwalya at humiling ng pagtiyak sa pagkuha. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 私が一緒に場所を見ます。ご自身のタオルを分けて取れるか確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Sasamahan ko sa lugar. Tiyakin kung maihihiwalay na makuha ang tuwalya.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。自分のタオルだけを確認して移し、ポーチの扱いは係に任せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 自分のタオルだけ移し他人の物は係に任せる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Salamat po. Sarili kong tuwalya lang ang titiyakin at ililipat; sa staff na ang pouch.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Sariling tuwalya lang ang ilipat at ipaubaya sa staff ang gamit ng iba. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では一緒に棚へ行きましょう。別の棚もその場でご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-ITABASHI-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Puntahan natin ang shelf. Doon din ituturo ang ibang shelf.
